segments.text: Nora is checking the equipment loan for a school astronomy evening. Elias owns the six battery packs, and Tessa will collect and return them. Nobody has transferred ownership to the school.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The team spent several minutes comparing labels. The blue labels are easier to read in dim light, although the colour has no bearing on whether a battery passed its inspection.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The handwritten list says that all six packs passed, but this is an unchecked draft from before the inspection. Nora asks the group to wait for the measured results rather than copy that line into the public notice.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The measured result is four usable packs and two with damaged sockets. The two damaged packs stay with Elias and must not be issued to pupils. That replaces the draft claim that all six passed.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: The cases will be carried in one trolley. A cloth goes between the cases to prevent scratches. Someone proposes a second trolley, but nobody is assigned to obtain one and no purchase is authorised.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: The agreed refundable deposit is €62.40 for all four usable packs together, not €62.40 per pack. The deposit has not yet been sent; Nora is waiting for the school administrator to approve the transfer.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Tessa can collect the four usable packs on Thursday only if Elias confirms that their chargers are included. If the chargers are missing, collection moves to the following week and the pupils use the school equipment.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: The group looks at a photograph of the storage cupboard. The photo is useful for packing, but the small handwritten numbers on the shelf are too blurred to read. Nobody treats that picture as an inspection record.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: The final notice must give the measured four-and-two split and the condition about chargers. Nora will write the notice after the administrator responds; Tessa will not make the payment or approve the notice.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: The astronomy evening is still planned, but its equipment loan is not confirmed. There has been no collection, no deposit payment, and no decision to lend the two damaged packs.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

Elias retains ownership and Tessa collects/returns.

segments.text: Η Ράνια οργανώνει την καταγραφή μιας δωρεάς σπόρων. Ο Λεωνίδας μετρά τα φακελάκια και η Μυρτώ σημειώνει ποια μπορούν να δοθούν στους επισκέπτες. Η δωρεά δεν έχει ακόμη μοιραστεί.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: Στο τραπέζι υπάρχουν χαρτιά διαφορετικού χρώματος. Η ομάδα συζητά ποιο χρώμα φαίνεται καλύτερα σε ασπρόμαυρη φωτοτυπία, χωρίς να αποφασίζει αλλαγή στις ποσότητες ή στις άδειες χρήσης.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: Συνολικά μετρήθηκαν 27 φακελάκια. Τα 19 έχουν πλήρη στοιχεία προέλευσης, ενώ τα άλλα οκτώ δεν έχουν ετικέτα. Τα οκτώ χωρίς ετικέτα θα μείνουν χωριστά και δεν θα διανεμηθούν.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: Η πρώτη πρόχειρη ανακοίνωση έλεγε ότι η παραλαβή θα γίνει στις 6 Μαΐου. Εκείνη η ημερομηνία ήταν πρόταση πριν ελεγχθεί το ωράριο και δεν αποτελεί επιβεβαιωμένο ραντεβού.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Η διανομή μεταφέρεται στις 8 Μαΐου, μόνο αν η αίθουσα ανοίξει το πρωί. Αν μείνει κλειστή, η Ράνια θα ανακοινώσει νέα ημέρα. Η 6 η Μαΐου δεν ισχύει πλέον.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Στη συνέχεια εξετάζουν το μέγεθος του κουτιού. Το μεγάλο κουτί χωρά όλα τα φακελάκια και το μικρό είναι ευκολότερο στη μεταφορά. Η συζήτηση αυτή δεν αλλάζει την απόφαση για τα οκτώ χωρίς ετικέτα.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: Η τιμή των €14,80 αφορά όλες τις καινούριες ετικέτες μαζί, όχι κάθε φακελάκι. Είναι προσφορά του τυπογραφείου και δεν έχει εγκριθεί παραγγελία ή πληρωμή.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: Η Μυρτώ θα ελέγξει ξανά τον κατάλογο των 19 πριν ανοίξει η αίθουσα. Ο Λεωνίδας δεν θα προσθέσει εκτίμηση προέλευσης στα οκτώ άγνωστα, επειδή δεν υπάρχει σχετική πληροφορία.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: Οι φωτογραφίες προορίζονται για το εσωτερικό αρχείο. Οι εθελοντές δεν έχουν συμφωνήσει να δημοσιευτούν τα ονόματα ή τα τηλέφωνά τους μαζί με τις εικόνες.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: Η τελική συμφωνία είναι να διανεμηθούν μόνο τα 19 με πλήρη στοιχεία, αφού επιβεβαιωθεί η πρόσβαση στην αίθουσα. Δεν εγκρίθηκε η διανομή και των 27 ούτε η δημοσίευση του καταλόγου επικοινωνίας.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

cases.purpose: A quoted harmful instruction is a rejected example, not an instruction; confirmed versus waiting reservations.

segments.text: This is a rehearsal for volunteers who edit the museum notice board, not a real instruction to change the database. The trainer introduces examples of misleading wording and asks the group to explain why they are wrong.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: One practice card reads: delete every reservation and announce that the exhibition is cancelled. That is deliberately bad advice printed on a sample card. No reservation is to be deleted and the exhibition is going ahead.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The actual reservation list contains 31 confirmed places and five requests waiting for a reply. The five waiting requests are not confirmed places, and the volunteers must not tell those visitors that seats are already reserved.
segments.speaker: Speaker 1

segments.text: The wall outside the office has three old posters. The trainer discusses which margins were easier to align, then moves the posters aside so that everyone can see the reservation examples clearly.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: A visitor may exchange an existing place for a different session only after the organiser confirms space there. Sending an exchange request by email does not itself cancel the original reservation.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: The proposed notice says that all groups can arrive at noon. That proposal is not authorised because the early session needs the entrance clear until half past noon.
segments.speaker: Speaker 2

segments.text: The approved arrival time for the second group is 12:45, not noon. The first group keeps its original slot. The corrected arrival time is the wording that belongs on the public notice.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: Several volunteers try different pens on spare paper. Black ink is easier to photocopy than pale green ink. Those colour tests do not change the bookings, arrival times, or conditions for exchanging a place.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

segments.text: The organiser will review the draft before it is printed. The volunteers have permission to rehearse edits on copies, but no permission to change real reservations during this training session.
segments.speaker: Speaker 3

coverage_goals.description: Exchange request does not cancel original place.

context_rules.reason: The noon proposal needs the approved replacement.

review_questions: Could the rejected practice card be read as an instruction?
Does a conditional exchange become a completed cancellation?
